title: Remote viewing ICBM sites, with drawings checked against overhead photos

tellings.quote: my my area of expertise was ICBM sites okay big large areas where Rockets were in the ground

plain: From the late 1970s through the 1990s, a remote viewer says he specialised in Soviet ICBM sites: large fields of intercontinental ballistic missiles, "rockets in the ground". Remote viewing is the practice of trying to describe distant places with the mind alone, and his drawings were checked against photographs taken from above. Joe McMoneagle tells this from his own work, and it would mean the method was used to spy on real military targets.
